Grounded woo-woo to get what you want quick ↓

*I know I speak quickly—I had a lot to cover in a 1:30 here’s a breakdown with a bonus at the bottom!

Step 1: write down what you’re “manifesting” — is it money, a relationship, your dream house?

Step 2: get clear on what you’re wanting with that thing and write it down— for example, if you’re manifesting $10k+ months in your business, are you wanting more ease and freedom? If you’re attracting your dream relationship are you wanting more acceptance?

Step 3: write down an extensive list (no matter how small) of everything that you already have in your life that makes you feel that feeling

Step 4: Feel it in your body. Allow yourself to be present with all of the ways that what you want is currently here!

*a big mistake people make here is they compare themselves to where they currently are and where they want to be. This puts us into a place of lack and discontentment.

The more than we can train ourselves to recognize what’s currently here we are able to:

→ Feel happier NOW with what we currently have (which is the KEY because I know so many very wealthy people who have gotten to their goals and they don’t actually feel the fulfillment or whatever they were going after in the first place.. this step helps you actually get what you want at a deeper level).

→ Amplify that feeling (no matter how small) and grow upon what’s already here — this makes that reality feel more accessible/feel possible to us because we can already feel it

BONUS: get an app like Parrot and record yourself reading the list of ways you already have what you want. Set it on a 30 minute timer as you fall asleep (this can help bring in repetitions to your reticular activation system and I’ve found helps sink into my subconscious better).

I’m going to make more neuroscience behind manifestation videos of these if you like them, so let me know in the comments and send it to someone who needs to hear it ✨
